name: pkill
description: Signal processes selected by name and other attributes

options.name: --signal
options.description: Signal to send instead of TERM, as a name or number (procps-ng)

name: -f
--full
options.description: Match against the full command line instead of just the process name

name: -x
--exact
options.description: Match only processes whose name exactly equals the pattern

name: -i
--ignore-case
options.description: Match case insensitively

name: -n
--newest
options.description: Select only the most recently started matching process

name: -o
--oldest
options.description: Select only the least recently started matching process

name: -g
--pgroup
options.description: Match only processes in the listed process group IDs

name: -G
--group
options.description: Match only processes whose real group ID is listed

name: -P
--parent
options.description: Match only child processes of the listed parents

name: -s
--session
options.description: Match only processes in the listed session IDs

name: -t
--terminal
options.description: Match only processes attached to the listed controlling terminals

name: -u
--euid
options.description: Match only processes whose effective user ID is listed

name: -U
--uid
options.description: Match only processes whose real user ID is listed

name: -F
--pidfile
options.description: Restrict matches to the PIDs read from the given file

name: -L
--logpidfile
options.description: Fail if the pidfile given with -F is not locked

name: -c
--count
options.description: Print the number of matching processes (procps-ng)

name: -e
--echo
options.description: Display the name and PID of each process signalled (procps-ng)

name: -q
--queue
options.description: Integer value sent with the signal via sigqueue (procps-ng)

name: -H
--require-handler
options.description: Match only processes with a handler installed for the signal (procps-ng)

name: -O
--older
options.description: Match only processes started more than the given number of seconds ago (procps-…

name: -r
--runstates
options.description: Match only processes in the given run states, e.g. D,S,Z (procps-ng)

name: -A
--ignore-ancestors
options.description: Exclude this process' ancestors from the matches (procps-ng)

options.name: --cgroup
options.description: Match only processes in the listed cgroup v2 names (procps-ng)

options.name: --ns
options.description: Match only processes in the same namespaces as the given PID (procps-ng)

options.name: --nslist
options.description: Namespaces considered by --ns: ipc, mnt, net, pid, user, uts (procps-ng)

options.name: -a
options.description: Include this process' ancestors in the matches (BSD/macOS)

options.name: -I
options.description: Request confirmation before signalling each process (BSD/macOS)

options.name: -S
options.description: Search for matches among system processes (BSD/macOS)

options.name: -v
options.description: Select processes that do not match the pattern (BSD/macOS)

name: -h
--help
options.description: Display help and exit

name: -V
--version
options.description: Display version information and exit
